alt: 園丁拆下把水灑到石路上的噴水器，改把滴灌水管鋪在菜根旁，右側菜苗長得青綠。
scene_prompt: Community gardeners change an ineffective method while keeping the same goal: at left wilted plants sit under a useless overhead sprinkler that wets only a stone path; in center the gardeners disconnect that sprinkler; at right they install a simple drip hose directly along the roots of the same continuous vegetable bed, where plants are healthier. Concrete change in method to grow vegetables, no arrows or writing.
